newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-RAMS FIRE COACH RICH BROOKS AFTER 6-10 SEASON.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-RAMS FIRE COACH RICH BROOKS AFTER 6-10 SEASON.

text.p: The St. Louis Rams fired coach Rich Brooks after he finished with a 6-10 season on Sunday.

"After several weeks of considerable thought and analysis, we believe it's in the best interest of our football team to make a change now. We owe it to the fans who helped bring the Rams to St. Louis," team president John Shaw said at a news conference.
Brooks was fired after ending the season with consecutive wins, including Saturday's 14-13 triumph over New Orleans.

After a 42-6 loss to Pittsburgh on November 3rd, Brooks was given a seven-game mandate by management. He went 4-3 to close the season and, following Saturday's win, said he characterised the team as "improved."
Brooks, 55, was 13-19 in two seasons in St. Louis. His tenure started promisingly with four straight wins, but the Rams lost nine of their last 12 games last season.
Brooks signed a four-year contract to coach the Rams in 1995 after 18 years at the University of Oregon.
